scope: Describe observable appearance, not diagnose diseases. 70 training images, 4 validation anchors.

surface.front: upper leaf surface impression, relatively flat veins

marks.subtle: main leaf mostly green/pale-green, diffuse tone/texture or sparse tiny points; no clearly conspicuous localized brown/white lesion or damaged patch
marks.conspicuous: one or more obvious localized brown/white/dark patches, conspicuous pale ring spots, damaged/necrotic-looking edges or holes dominate local attention

hard_shadow: boolean: clear cast-shadow edge crosses principal leaf, dark surrounding background alone does not count
bright_patch: boolean: main leaf has strongly illuminated or washed-out local area, not merely light green color
broad_view: boolean: one broad unfolded leaf face fills a substantial frame area, not a narrow folded leaf or distant canopy
note: brief visible evidence; avoid disease identification; uncertain when necessary
matching: After all annotation, count training examples matching validation anchor surface + marks + hard_shadow + bright_patch + broad_view exactly. Also report relaxed surface+marks matches. Do not invent a numerical sufficiency threshold.
